item.title: Gaza does not need new overlords
item.description: The U.S. plan for Gaza is the final stage of Israel’s genocide. Bombs and bulldozers obliterated Gaza’s landscape, and now skyscrapers and data centers aim to dismantle its social fabric and capacity to resist.

item.title: In defense of de-platforming Zionists on college campuses
item.description: The debate over de-platforming Zionists isn't about free speech but whether Zionism deserves a platform in a civilized learning community. Haviv Rettig Gur's talk at Haverford College, justifying the Gaza genocide, shows the answer is 'no.'

item.title: Tucker Carlson’s criticism of Israel misses the point
item.description: We spoke to the founder of Palestinian Christian theology. He says Tucker Carlson can’t support Christians in the Holy Land if he doesn’t support Palestinian freedom.

item.title: New Israeli poll shows young Jewish voters most right-wing, fanatically religious, and pro-genocide in Israeli history
item.description: A poll conducted by Israel's Channel 12 found the half a million new Jewish Israeli voters are the most right-wing and religiously fanatic in Israel's history. They're voting in the upcoming Knesset elections.

item.title: Inside Saudi Arabia’s regional realignment
item.description: Saudi Arabia is shifting toward a major realignment of its foreign policy and global role. This goes far beyond its rivalry with the United Arab Emirates — it includes a complete rethinking of its relationship with the U.S. and Israel.

item.title: Israel’s legitimacy was on thin ice at the Winter Olympics. It’s just the beginning.
item.description: What we saw at the Olympics is the eruption of popular discontent, not only with Israel, but with the power structures that protected and enabled the genocide. And while Israel continues to be allowed into such events, the boos are growing louder.

item.title: Understanding the U.S. and Israel’s illegal war on Iran
item.description: The illegal U.S.-Israeli war on Iran continues a rampage that has devastated countries and international institutions to eliminate all obstacles to U.S. hegemony. The U.S.-Israel Axis has not succeeded yet, and it is up to the world to stop them.

item.title: The U.S. media goes to war on Iran
item.description: The U.S. media is predictably spreading government propaganda and ignoring Israel’s role as it cheers on the war against Iran and pushes for regime change.

item.title: Netanyahu finally gets his war on Iran
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu may have finally gotten the war on Iran he's long pushed the U.S. toward, but he also ignited the domestic battle over the U.S.-Israel relationship.

item.title: Rubio confirms the heresy: the U.S. went to war in Iran because of Israel
item.description: The heresy of Walt and Mearsheimer's Israel lobby theory was the claim that Israel and its supporters pushed the U.S. into war. Marco Rubio has now confirmed this analysis when he admitted that Trump went to war with Iran because of Israel.
